name: Vernal-Firth
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past towering mountain ranges, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls nitrogen controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
